lines.password: [whispering, playful] Psst! Here is your secret bunny entrance. Type your invitation password to see the surprise!
lines.password-error: [gently teasing] Oops! That code doesn't look quite right. Try another one!
lines.intro: [bright, mischievous] Well, hello there! My name's Bunny. I brought a letter, a bow tie, and absolutely zero qualifications for this job. [chuckles]
lines.ask: [curious, cheeky] Ehhh... Alex has a question for ya. He sent a rabbit. Bold choice, huh? [laughs softly]
lines.yes: [delighted] Oh my goodness! This calls for a happy bunny dance! [excited chuckle]
lines.outing: [playful] Here is the fun part! Coffee, wandering, food or sweets? I did not even put carrot farming on the list!
lines.detail-coffee: [amused] Coffee? Excellent! I like mine with two carrots. I know, I know... weird.
lines.detail-walk: [confident, playful] I am extremely good at walking! Except when there's a carrot shop nearby.
lines.detail-food: [hungry, joking] Food? Now we're speaking my language. Does the menu have carrot cake?
lines.detail-sweet: [delighted] Sweet treats! I have been training for this question my entire bunny life!
lines.detail-surprise: [mysterious, playful] A surprise! Ooh, I love a mystery. Especially when nobody hides my carrots.
lines.area: [warm] Somewhere comfortable for you, of course. My hop-mobile has a very limited range.
lines.schedule: [excited, warm] Aha! The calendar! Pick a day that works for you. This rabbit does not do surprise alarms.
lines.success: [celebrating] Well, would ya look at that! Mission accomplished! I knew this bow tie had magical powers!
lines.decline: [kind, gentle] Hey, no worries! Thanks for being straight with me. Here's a little flower, on the house.
